synthesis.body: Before pinning a file with a content hash, list every write the surrounding workflow *requires* after the pin is taken. A lifecycle field the process itself bumps (a status token, a progress checkbox, a generated timestamp) will invalidate the pin one mandated step later, and the failure looks like tampering rather than a design error. Hash a canonical form that normalizes exactly the fields the workflow writes, and nothing else. Two traps when implementing it: substitute the token by a span-bounded splice, not str.replace, because the token usually recurs in a trailing vocabulary comment on the same line; and check whether any test already encodes the broken behaviour as intended, because those tests go green-to-red and read as regressions.

title: Hashing an artifact your own workflow mandates editing breaks by construction
